What if you visited America for the very first time?

Tourists say these surprises hit them right away. One, portions are huge, and a medium drink can be the size of a large elsewhere. Two, many restaurants give free refills on soda. Three, cars everywhere, and lots of suburbs have no sidewalks at all.

But here's the twist. Four, people put the American flag on houses, cars and even clothes. Five, medicine ads on TV, because the US is one of only two countries that allow drug ads aimed at patients. The other one is New Zealand!
